name: shadcn/improve
title: shadcn/improve
headline: shadcn/improve: strong model plans, cheaper models execute
lede: You can have your most capable model audit a codebase and write plans that cheaper models then carry out.

effects.effect: Normalises tiered model pipelines for code changes
Raises demand for cheap reliable executor models

possibilities.title: AWS teams reuse one cached plan so cheap models execute large refactors

with.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro available on Amazon Bedrock

possibilities.connection: shadcn/improve splits work into a plan written once by a strong model, and Kimi K3.1 Pro on Bedrock offers explicit prompt caching, so the shared plan becomes a cached prefix every executor call reuses.

works_with.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro available on Amazon Bedrock
via: AWS teams reuse one cached plan so cheap models execute large refactors

appearances.headline: shadcn/improve: strong model plans, cheaper models execute
appearances.newly_possible: You can have your most capable model audit a codebase and write plans that cheaper models then carry out.
appearances.why: Splitting planning from execution can cut model spend on large code changes.
appearances.limits: No cost or quality savings are measured in the input.
